Template function for TealReportCard creation and customization

Source: R/utils.R
report_card_template.Rd

This function generates a report card with a title, an optional description, and the option to append the filter state list.

Usage

report_card_template(
  title,
  label,
  description = NULL,
  with_filter,
  filter_panel_api
)

Arguments

title

(character(1)) title of the card (unless overwritten by label)

label

(character(1)) label provided by the user when adding the card

description

(character(1)) optional, additional description

with_filter

(logical(1)) flag indicating to add filter state

filter_panel_api

(FilterPanelAPI) object with API that allows the generation of the filter state in the report

Value

(TealReportCard) populated with a title, description and filter state.

See also

See teal_card() and the vignette about the teal report vignette('teal-report-class', 'teal.reporter')

Examples

filtered_data <- teal.slice::init_filtered_data(list(iris = list(dataset = iris)))
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
card <- report_card_template(
  title = "Iris",
  label = "",
  description = "Summary of the iris dataset.",
  with_filter = TRUE,
  filter_panel_api = teal.slice::FilterPanelAPI$new(filtered_data)
)
} # }
